content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Presets stripe

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a self-owned, fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This approach matters because it empowers digital creators to take control of their sales and customer data, without relying on third-party platforms that may exclude their country or impose restrictive terms. By owning their infrastructure, creators can ensure a permanent and stable presence in the global digital marketplace.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-16|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] of sovereign commerce infrastructure is built around a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Additionally, NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, enabling creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators, who sell digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, require a reliable and efficient way to process payments and deliver products to their customers. By providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, we enable these creators to participate fully in the global digital economy.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators to take control of their sales and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Each component is carefully selected to ensure seamless integration, security, and scalability. For example, Cloudflare Pages and Workers provide a fast and secure hosting solution, while Supabase offers a reliable and scalable order storage system. NOWPayments, with its support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, enables creators to accept a wide range of payments from customers worldwide.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. They can choose from a range of hosting options, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and select a suitable backend logic solution, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can get started quickly, as it includes Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff, along with 30-day support.

If you're a digital creator in a country where Stripe is not available, you can sell digital products without relying on Stripe by using a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach enables you to own your online store, process payments in cryptocurrencies, and deliver products instantly, all while maintaining full control over your customer data and sales.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, choose a backend logic solution, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure file delivery with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing and verify your domain with SPF/DKIM/DMARC to ensure secure email delivery.
